name: Marcus Real Estate - Market Report Generator

parameters.jsCode:
// Assemble final market report with all components const data = $('Calculate Market Statistics').item.json; const claudeResponse = $('Claude AI Market Analysis').item.json; const aiAnalysis = claudeResponse.content?.[0]?.text || ''; // Extract HTML from Claude response (handles markdown code blocks) let analysisHtml = aiAnalysis; const htmlMatch = aiAnalysis.match(/```html\s*([\s\S]*?)```/); if (htmlMatch) { analysisHtml = htmlMatch[1].trim(); } // Build comparable sales table const salesTableRows = data.recentSales.map(sale => ` ${sale.address} $${sale.price.toLocaleString()} ${sale.beds || 'N/A'} ${sale.baths || 'N/A'} ${sale.sqft?.toLocaleString() || 'N/A'} ${sale.daysOnMarket || 'N/A'} ${new Date(sale.date).toLocaleDateString()} `).join(''); // Build current listings table const listingsTableRows = data.listingsToWatch.map(listing => ` $${listing.ListPrice.toLocaleString()} ${listing.BedroomsTotal || 'N/A'} ${listing.BathroomsTotalInteger || 'N/A'} ${listing.LivingArea?.toLocaleString() || 'N/A'} $${Math.round(listing.pricePerSqft)} ${listing.DaysOnMarket || 0} `).join(''); const fullReportHtml = `

📊 ${data.neighborhood} Market Report

90-Day Analysis | Generated ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}

${data.stats.marketTemp}

📈 Key Market Metrics

Avg Sold Price
$${data.stats.avgSoldPrice.toLocaleString()}
Days on Market
${data.stats.avgDaysOnMarket}
Price/SqFt
$${data.stats.avgPricePerSqft}
Homes Sold
${data.stats.totalSold}
Active Listings
${data.stats.activeListings}
Median Price
$${data.stats.medianSoldPrice.toLocaleString()}
${analysisHtml}

🏘️ Recent Comparable Sales

${salesTableRows}
Address Price Beds Baths Sq Ft Days on Market Sold Date

🏠 Current Listings to Watch

These properties offer the best value per square foot currently on the market:

${listingsTableRows}
Price Beds Baths Sq Ft $/SqFt Days Listed

Questions about this market?

Let's discuss what these numbers mean for you!
Marcus
📧 {{ $env.AGENT_EMAIL }} | 📞 {{ $env.AGENT_PHONE }}

`; return [{ json: { ...data, reportHtml: fullReportHtml, reportSubject: `${data.neighborhood} Market Report - ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}` } }];

parameters.content:
## MARKET REPORT GENERATOR

Trigger via:
1. Webhook/API: POST to /market-report
   Body: {"neighborhood": "Oak Park", "email": "client@email.com"}
2. Manual execution
3. Slack command (optional)

Features:
- Fetches 90-day sales + active listings from MLS
- Claude AI generates professional analysis
- Beautiful HTML report with:
  - Market statistics dashboard
  - AI-powered insights
  - Comparable sales table
  - Current listings to watch
  - Price charts (optional)
- Emails report to client
- Logs to Google Sheet

Batch support:
- Multiple neighborhoods in one call
- Example: {"neighborhoods": "Oak Park, Riverside, Downtown"}

Saves 20+ hours monthly!
Automate quarterly reports to past clients.
